Many people don't see or understand "dividend growth".  Example : in 1988 Warren Buffett boutght 1.3 billion dollars of the boring CocaCola company that pays what LOOKS like a boring 3 or 4 % dividend.  Today Buffett's Coke stock is worth 37 Billion--a 27400% increase.  The percentage payout was basically the same but as Coke slowly increased in share price , that same percentage payout is huge.   Albert Einstein said compound interest was the 8th wonder of the world.      Good luck everyone.😀   The trick to all of this is that SCHD since inception has an average increase in dividend of 11%.   This means if all things stay the same, SCHD dividend payout would double in 7 years.
